{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool blend coat in deep charcoal gray, tailored fit, knee-length, #36454F.
A fine-gauge merino sweater in oatmeal cream, crewneck, hip-length, #E8E0D6.
High-rise straight-leg trousers in brown suede, ankle length, #9C704C.
Chelsea boots in dark cognac leather, ankle-high, #5C3A21.
A minimalist gold hoop earring and a structured leather tote bag.
This outfit works perfectly for a rainy autumn client meeting because the wool coat offers essential protection against the cold while maintaining a polished silhouette. The neutral color palette of charcoal, oatmeal, and cognac feels sophisticated yet approachable for a coffee shop setting without appearing too rigid. By choosing suede and knit textures over stiff formal fabrics, the ensemble honors the casual nature of a cafe meeting while remaining professional enough to impress a client."}
